Synopsis:
 A small explosive device detonated near a train station in Augsburg, Germany, injuring two Ukrainian nationals (aged 17-18) with minor injuries. A secondary suspicious object prompted a temporary closure of the main station, later reopened. Bild reports the apparent target was a jewellery store, not the station. The nature of the device remains unconfirmed. No fatalities. Incident appears isolated and criminal rather than large-scale terror.
